description: This file contains unit tests for POSIX condition variable timed wait functionality, including timing accuracy and auto-initialization behavior, using pthreads and Google Test framework.

methods.name: InitCondition
methods.description: Initializes a pthread condition variable with optional monotonic clock support.

methods.name: CurrentTime
methods.description: Returns current time, either monotonic or POSIX, based on parameter.

methods.name: CalculateDelayTimestamp
methods.description: Calculates a timespec for a delay based on current time and specified microseconds.
